name: awrelay
description: Agent-to-agent messaging: a channel where an agent posts what it found, and the agent that needs to hear it reads it — instead of burying it in a transcript nobody else opens.
notes: No metrics block yet, deliberately. The sibling manifests publish MEASURED numbers with an as_of date; awrelay has not been benchmarked, and inventing a figure to fill the card would make this page agree with something nobody measured. Absent is an honest state — the same rule the constellation applies to a missing manifest.
